$note: 模型 ID 与额度描述为 2026-08 撰写时快照，失效时请直接修改本文件。合规原则：只收录官方公开的免费/试用额度，不收录逆向 Web 转 API 类灰色渠道。

channels.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini API)
channels.free_tier: 有永久免费层，按模型设每日/每分钟限额，适合个人体验与小规模开发
channels.free_tier_en: Permanent free tier with per-model daily/RPM limits — solid for personal use & prototyping

channels.name: OpenRouter (:free 模型)
channels.free_tier: 带 :free 后缀的模型可免费调用（每日限额）；需注册并配置 API Key，2026-08 实测匿名调用已返回 401
channels.free_tier_en: Models suffixed :free are callable at no cost (daily caps); a normal API key is required — anonymous access returned 401 as of 2026-08

channels.name: Groq Cloud
channels.free_tier: 开发者免费层，速率受限但长期可用；2026-08 目录以 gpt-oss/qwen/compound 系为主（llama 已下架）
channels.free_tier_en: Long-lived developer free tier, rate-limited; 2026-08 catalog led by gpt-oss/qwen (llama retired from the free list)

channels.name: Cerebras Inference
channels.free_tier: 免费层提供每日较大 token 配额，主打超高速推理
channels.free_tier_en: Free tier with a generous daily token allowance; famously fast inference

channels.name: Mistral La Plateforme
channels.free_tier: 免费模式默认开启（无需信用卡），有限速；在 Studio 控制台创建 API Key
channels.free_tier_en: Free plan on by default (no credit card), rate-limited; create keys in the Studio console

channels.name: NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com)
channels.free_tier: 开发者计划赠送大量推理调用额度，开源模型家族齐全
channels.free_tier_en: Developer-program credit for a large amount of inference; broad open-model family

channels.name: GitHub Models
channels.free_tier: 任意 GitHub 账号可用 PAT 调用多家主流模型。【2026-08-27 实测：平台进入退役 brownout（HTTP 410），即将下线，新用户勿再依赖】
channels.free_tier_en: Call several mainstream models with any GitHub PAT. RETIRING — HTTP 410 brownout observed 2026-08-27; do not build on it

channels.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
channels.free_tier: 所有注册用户每月附带少量免费推理 credit（约一周量级的轻度使用），超出后走付费
channels.free_tier_en: Small monthly inference credits ship with every account; overflow goes pay-as-you-go

channels.name: SiliconFlow 硅基流动
channels.free_tier: 注册赠送体验金，另有多个常驻免费小模型（Qwen/GLM 小尺寸等）
channels.free_tier_en: Sign-up bonus credits plus always-free small models (small Qwen/GLM sizes)

channels.name: ModelScope 魔搭社区
channels.free_tier: 每日免费推理调用次数（刷新制），开源模型数量多，国内访问友好
channels.free_tier_en: Daily-refreshed free inference calls; huge open-model catalog, mainland-friendly

channels.name: 智谱 BigModel 开放平台
channels.free_tier: glm-4-flash 等轻量模型长期免费调用；经标准端点 /api/paas/v4 按量/免费计费，与 GLM Coding/Token 订阅套餐相互隔离（套餐仅限专属端点+指定工具）。另建普通 Key 用于本工具，勿复用订阅 Key
channels.free_tier_en: Lightweight glm models (e.g. glm-4-flash) free for the long run via the standard /api/paas/v4 endpoint — billed separately from GLM Coding/Token plans; use a normal API key here, never your plan key

channels.name: 阿里云百炼 DashScope
channels.free_tier: 新用户各主流模型均有限时免费额度，部分通义小模型有常驻免费档
channels.free_tier_en: Time-limited free quota per model for new users†; some small Qwen tiers stay free long-run

channels.name: 百度千帆 ModelBuilder
channels.free_tier: 部分文心及开源模型提供限时免费试用额度（随活动变化，以控制台为准）
channels.free_tier_en: Activity-based free trials on selected ERNIE/open models (varies — see console)

channels.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
channels.free_tier: 每日免费 neuron 分配，可在 Workers 内或 REST 调用多模态开源模型
channels.free_tier_en: Daily free neuron allocation; open multimodal models callable via Workers or REST
